name: jira_link
description: Links two Jira issues so that it reads 'from_key <verb> to_key', for example PROJ-1 blocks PROJ-2 with the default Blocks type. Use it when the user says one issue blocks, duplicates, clones or relates to another. Both issues must be in projects assigned to this assistant; it does not create issues (that is jira_create). Calling it twice may create a duplicate link, so never repeat a call that succeeded. Returns one line describing the link.

from_key.description: Key of the issue that blocks, duplicates or relates (e.g. PROJ-1).

to_key.description: Key of the other issue (e.g. PROJ-2).

link_type.description: Link type name in Jira (e.g. Blocks).
